purpose: validation set frozen BEFORE any arm of the target-revision round is trained

devSet.role: development regression only after this round; it produced the fix

overlapRule: signature = kind + subject + value, or kind + subject + from + to; matched against the training pools and against cf24

scoringRule.factLevel: S supported / O missing / C contradiction / A wrong subject, plus any new event outside the facts
scoringRule.sourceLevel: clean = every fact S and no added event
scoringRule.moved: v2 strict: both the start and the destination must be written; destination only counts as O
scoringRule.sanity: a perceptible direction is required; writing 上升/下降 or the bare value counts as O
scoringRule.no_change: one of the fixed "nothing new happened" phrasings
scoringRule.otherKinds: subject name plus >= 0.5 character-bigram coverage of the value text
scoringRule.aliases: place and object aliases do not count as additions
scoringRule.language: repetition and syntax are recorded separately; they do not change fact support

acceptance: judge on the independent slice; report devShared and trainingSeen separately and never pool them silently
decode: greedy, EOS or 20 s per unit, no length cap, CPU, same as the cf24 baseline
declaredAt: 2026-11-05, before any training run of this round
slicePrecedence: trainingSeen wins over devShared when a unit matches both
